pbg-artistoo

process-bigraph wrapper for the Artistoo Cellular Potts Model. Each simulation below is the real Artistoo simulator running in a Node.js subprocess, driven step-by-step from Python via ArtistooProcess.

Cell migration (Act model)Differential-adhesion sortingHigh-temperature fluid regime

Cell migration (Act model)

Adhesion + volume + perimeter + activity

Motile cells crawl across the lattice driven by the activity constraint. The activity strength (motility) is a live input a sibling process could modulate.

Differential-adhesion sorting

Non-motile sticky cells relax to an aggregate

With activity switched off and low cell-cell contact energy, adhesion drives the population toward a compact, well-connected aggregate.

High-temperature fluid regime

Raised Metropolis T destabilizes membranes

A high temperature setpoint makes cell boundaries fluctuate strongly — cells struggle to hold shape, illustrating the temperature input port's effect on the real Hamiltonian dynamics.
